intro: Between 12 and 30 April 2026, ZCyberNews published 74 articles under the supply-chain tag. The coverage documented activity from Lazarus Group, CanisterSprawl, and GRU, with critical vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-1731 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-39987 (CVSS 9.3), CVE-2026-40176, and CVE-2026-40177. Affected sectors spanned technology, software development, cryptocurrency, logistics, and manufacturing, with reports covering Global, North America, Europe, Asia, and Arctic regions. The severity mix comprised 45 high, 12 critical, 12 medium, and 4 informational entries.
